div.head: III Eg 8
div.ab: ⁊ ga an mynet ofer ealne þæs cynges anweald, ⁊ þane nan man ne forsace;
⁊ gange án mynet ofer ealne ðæs cynges anweald, ⁊ þæne nan man ne forsace.
⁊ gange an mynet ofer ealne þæs cynges anweald, ⁊ þæne nan man ne forsace.
Et sit una moneta per totum regis imperium, et nemo sonet eam;
[Be mynetum ⁊ gemettum.] [Ld] ⁊ gange án mynet ofer ealne þæs cyninges anweald, ⁊ þone nan man ne forsace.
And ga an mynet ofer ealne þæs cynges anweald, and þane nan man ne forsace.
And one coinage shall be current throughout all the king's realm, and no-one shall refuse it.
And there is to be one coinage throughout the king’s whole realm and no one may refuse it.
And one coinage is to be current throughout all the king’s dominion, and no man is to refuse it;
(Von Münzen und Maassen. Ld) Und es gehe Eine Münze über des Königs ganzes Gebiet, und die weise niemand zurück;
(Of coins and measures. Ld) And let one coinage be current throughout all the king's dominion, and let no one refuse it;

note.label: reinforces
note.quote: he reinforced Æthelstan's demand for a single currency throughout his realm with uniform measures and a fixed price for wool
